schema_sql: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS slowlog_repro

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS slowlog_repro.repro_events (id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, payload VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id)) ENGINE=InnoDB
